verdict.rationale: GitHub's own GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate and execute software development workflows in a repository, and it is backed by CI/CD, so GitHub does ship a first-party workflow engine. However, no evidence shows that these workflows can run on a recurring schedule, such as cron-style triggers. missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron triggers for workflows, recurrence configuration details, scheduled Copilot agent tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
